on OZ, there are a number of autoload properties that attempt
to read files of the LISP directory.  However, this directory does not
exist.  The files are actually on a directory LISP:<MACLISP>.  It seems that 
there are two easy ways to fix this.  Change the directory to <LISP> or change
the autoloads to refer to the LISP device.  We should do one or the other.
